scope_alignment.argument: Both 5.4 and 5.5 trace to the same single line (line 42). 5.4 (avatar.right=1526 at 1920) is the static-cap symptom: maxWidth caps at 800 regardless of viewport. 5.5 (toggle clustering) is the dynamic-cap symptom: when both open and closed states clamp to 800, the centered 800px box only shifts position when right-sidebar is added/removed — never widens. Removing the clamp fixes both symptoms simultaneously because the underlying reactive formula (already in place from Cycle 1) becomes the actual return value. Bundling 5.4 + 5.5 is justified, not hand-wavy.

novelty_check.assessment: BA correctly identifies this as a different sub-axis on the same L3 layer. Cycle 1 changed the *formula structure* (static→reactive); Cycle 6 changes the *terminal value* (clamp→passthrough). The two operations are independent and the second is the natural follow-up the prior cycle's R4 left open.
